title: Scientology and living in London
summary: He moved to London briefly in the early seventies when he began Scientology.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: When did you move to Europe?
I was married about ninety-seven or ninety-six and shortly after that.
Didn’t you live in London for a short time in the early seventies was it?

I did, yeah . . . it was the early seventies. I had started Scientology and . . . I think I worked at Ronnie Scott’s club once and walking through one street I noticed there was a Scientology place and that the rates were a lot cheaper . . . I got a nice
apartment there through some guy who wanted me to make a private record for him and he paid for the apartment. Things like that. That was a few months only.
